title: Club Membership: corporate wellness bundling basis
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which a Club Membership member who is also the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment may receive a bundled benefit, and the tier's own corporate-partner and multi-month-prepay discount percentages.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Corporate partner discount percentage | Multi-month prepay discount percentage |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | 0 percent | 5 percent |
| Student Metro Access | 0 percent | 5 percent |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | 0 percent | 5 percent |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | 10 percent | 8 percent |
| Premier All-Access | 10 percent | 10 percent |
| Black Card All-Access | 10 percent | 12 percent |
| Founding Legacy Access | 0 percent | 5 percent |

## Eligibility: the linked corporate wellness enrollment must be active
This bundling basis applies only while the member's linked corporate wellness enrollment's own status is active, and only while the member is that enrollment's own customer. This check is based on the corporate wellness enrollment's own system record of its current status, correlated to the specific member linked to it.

## Retired clauses: recurring dues corporate discount and its stacking rule no longer govern here
Three clauses of this basis are no longer in force. The clause granting the tier's flat corporate partner discount percentage off monthly dues on each recurring dues charge is no longer in force: which corporate-linked discount percentage actually reduces a recurring dues charge, and how it is chosen, is now governed by a different, wider comparison than the flat corporate-partner percentage shown above. The clause excluding the multi-month prepay discount percentage from stacking with this benefit on the same charge is no longer in force in its original form: the prepay discount's own relationship to a recurring dues charge's discount is now governed as part of that same wider comparison, rather than as a stacking exclusion stated here. The clause confining this benefit to only a recurring dues charge is also no longer in force: the corporate-linked benefit this basis describes is no longer confined to only that one billing subtype, since a comparable employer-funded benefit now also extends to a different billing subtype under its own separate governing basis. The tier's own corporate partner discount percentage and multi-month prepay discount percentage shown above remain valid tier figures in their own right, unaffected by which clause governs their application to any particular charge.

## Points of judgement
A member who is the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment, but whose enrollment has lapsed to an inactive status, does not receive this bundling basis's benefit until that enrollment is active again.

this discount does not stack with multi_month_prepay_discount_pct on the same charge
